intake_agent.role: Parse the customer complaint into a structured claim (LLM)

customer_agent.role: Resolve customer identity and prior order history

order_product_agent.role: Order status, item rows, sellers, products and categories

delivery_agent.role: Delivery variance and per-seller handoff variance

policy_agent.role: Apply EC_POLICY_V2 (rule engine, authoritative) and cross-check with an LLM adjudicator

critic_agent.role: Attack the draft resolution for contradictions against the facts (LLM)

verifier_agent.role: Validate schema, array caps, null handling and evidence IDs against the CSVs
